title: Sample idea: AI triage of support tickets
idea: Let an AI read every incoming support ticket, set its priority and send it to the right team.

rounds.name: Opening positions
notes: Tickets sit for hours just waiting to be sorted. Triage is the bottleneck.
An angry customer marked low priority by a model gets ignored. I think a person should see anything about money or safety.
How accurate is the routing? Compare it to how agents sorted last month's tickets first.
Unsure tickets should go to a human queue, not a guess.
Start with routing only. Priority is the riskier part.
rounds.card: An AI routes incoming tickets to teams; unsure cases and anything about money or safety go to a person.
credits: anything about money or safety go to a person

rounds.name: Pushback and concessions
notes: Okay, routing first. Priority stays with people until the routing proves itself.
Customers should know a person can step in. Say it in the auto-reply.
Backtest on three months of tickets. Go live only above 90 percent agreement.
Spammers will learn the keywords that jump the queue.
Then routing ignores urgency words. It only picks the team.
rounds.card: An AI picks the team for each ticket after a three-month backtest above 90 percent; money, safety and unsure cases go to a person, and priority stays human, and the auto-reply says a person can step in.
credits: picks the team for each ticket
the auto-reply says a person can step in

rounds.name: Best version
notes: Misroutes should feed back weekly so the routing improves.
Machine sorts, people judge. Each part plays to its strength.
Log every routing decision with its reason so we can audit it.
rounds.card: Routing only, live after a backtest above 90 percent, with human review for money, safety and unsure cases, every decision logged, and weekly misroute feedback, and the auto-reply says a person can step in.

gates.finding: Tickets reach the right team in minutes.
Ticket text and team list already exist.
Personal data in tickets goes to the model.
gates.change: Mask card numbers and addresses before routing.

gates.finding: One rule: it only picks the team.

final: An AI picks the right team for each new ticket, going live only after a three-month backtest above 90 percent agreement. Card numbers and addresses are masked first. Anything about money, safety or low confidence goes to a person, priority stays human, every decision is logged with a reason, and misroutes feed back weekly. Every auto-reply says a person can step in.
changed: Money, safety and unsure cases to a person
dissent: The Advocate wants customers to be able to opt out of AI routing entirely.
